title: be动词：am / is / are
summary: 英语中最基础的动词，用于描述状态、身份、特征
structure: 主语 + am/is/are + 表语（名词/形容词/介词短语）
explanation: be动词根据主语变化：I用am；he/she/it及单数名词用is；you/we/they及复数名词用are。否定句在be动词后加not，疑问句将be动词提到句首。

examples.en: I am a student.
She is very friendly.
They are at home now.

practice.question: He ___ my brother.
practice.explanation: 主语he为第三人称单数，用is。

practice.question: We ___ ready for the trip.
practice.explanation: 主语we为复数，用are。

practice.question: I ___ not tired at all.
practice.explanation: 主语I固定搭配am。

title: 一般现在时
summary: 表示经常性、习惯性动作或客观事实
structure: 主语 + 动词原形（第三人称单数加-s/-es） + ...
explanation: 一般现在时常与always、usually、often、every day等时间状语连用。当主语是he/she/it时，动词要加-s或-es；否定句用don't/doesn't+动词原形；疑问句用Do/Does提问。

examples.en: She works in a hospital.
I don't like coffee.
Does he play basketball?

practice.question: My mother ___ (cook) dinner every evening.
practice.explanation: 主语为第三人称单数，动词加-s。

practice.question: They ___ (not like) horror movies.
practice.explanation: 主语they为复数，否定用don't+动词原形。

practice.question: ___ you speak French?
practice.explanation: 主语you，一般现在时疑问句用Do。

title: 一般过去时
summary: 表示过去发生的动作或状态
structure: 主语 + 动词过去式（规则动词加-ed，不规则动词需记忆） + ...
explanation: 常与yesterday、last week、in 2020等表示过去的时间状语连用。否定句用didn't+动词原形；疑问句用Did提问，句中动词还原为原形。

examples.en: I visited my grandmother last weekend.
examples.zh: 我上周末去看望了我的祖母。

examples.en: She didn't finish her homework.
Did you watch the game last night?

practice.question: He ___ (go) to Paris last summer.
practice.explanation: go的过去式是不规则变化went。

practice.question: We ___ (not see) the movie yet.
practice.explanation: 一般过去时否定用didn't+动词原形。

practice.question: ___ she call you yesterday?
practice.explanation: 过去时疑问句用Did提问。

title: 现在进行时
summary: 表示此刻正在发生的动作
explanation: 常与now、right now、at the moment连用，表示说话时正在进行的动作，也可表示近期计划好的安排。

examples.en: I am studying English right now.
They are having lunch at the moment.
Is it raining outside?

practice.question: Look! The baby ___ (sleep).
practice.explanation: look提示此刻正在发生，用现在进行时。

practice.question: She ___ (not work) today.
practice.explanation: 现在进行时否定：be动词+not+动词-ing。

practice.question: What ___ you ___ (do) now?
practice.explanation: 现在进行时疑问句：be动词+主语+动词-ing。

title: 现在完成时
summary: 表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果
structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
explanation: 常与already、just、yet、ever、never、since、for连用。强调过去动作与现在的联系，而不强调具体发生的时间点。

examples.en: I have already finished my homework.
She has never been to Japan.
Have you eaten breakfast yet?

practice.question: He ___ (live) here for ten years.
practice.explanation: for ten years提示持续到现在，用现在完成时。

practice.question: I ___ (not see) that movie yet.
practice.explanation: yet常与现在完成时连用，否定用haven't+过去分词。

practice.question: ___ you ever ___ (try) sushi?
practice.explanation: ever常与现在完成时连用，疑问句：Have+主语+过去分词。

title: 情态动词：can / could / must / should
summary: 表达能力、许可、义务、建议等
structure: 主语 + 情态动词 + 动词原形
explanation: can表示能力/许可；could是can的过去式或更委婉的说法；must表示必须/强烈推测；should表示建议。情态动词后必须接动词原形，否定句直接加not。

examples.en: I can swim very well.
You must finish this report today.
examples.zh: 你今天必须完成这份报告。

examples.en: You should drink more water.

practice.question: You ___ smoke in the hospital.
practice.explanation: 情态动词否定直接加not：must not（禁止）。

practice.question: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
practice.explanation: Could用于礼貌地请求许可。

practice.question: She ___ speak three languages.
practice.explanation: 情态动词没有单三形式，且后接动词原形。

title: 比较级与最高级
summary: 比较两个或多个事物的性质、程度
structure: 比较级：形容词+er / more+形容词 + than；最高级：the+形容词+est / the most+形容词
explanation: 单音节和部分双音节词加-er/-est；三音节及以上词用more/most；不规则变化需记忆，如good-better-best, bad-worse-worst。

examples.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
examples.zh: 这本书比那本书更有趣。

examples.en: She is the tallest girl in her class.
examples.zh: 她是她班上最高的女孩。

examples.en: Health is more important than money.

practice.question: Today is ___ (hot) than yesterday.
practice.explanation: 两者比较用比较级，hot为单音节，重复辅音字母加er。

practice.question: This is ___ (good) restaurant in town.
practice.explanation: good的最高级是不规则变化best。

practice.question: He is ___ (careful) than his brother.
practice.explanation: careful是多音节词，比较级用more+形容词。

title: 常见介词：in / on / at
summary: 介词用于表示时间、地点等关系
structure: in（较大的时间/空间范围）、on（具体某天/表面）、at（具体时刻/地点）
explanation: 时间上：in用于年、月、季节（in 2024, in July）；on用于具体日期、星期（on Monday）；at用于具体时刻（at 8 o'clock）。地点上：in表示在内部，on表示在表面，at表示在某一点。

examples.en: I was born in 2000.
The meeting is on Friday.
Let's meet at the entrance at 9 am.
examples.zh: 我们上午9点在入口处见面吧。

practice.question: She was born ___ July.
practice.explanation: 月份前用in。

practice.question: The book is ___ the table.
practice.explanation: 书在桌子表面，用on。

practice.question: I'll see you ___ noon.
practice.explanation: 具体时刻用at。

title: 从句基础：定语从句与时间状语从句
summary: 用一个句子修饰名词或表示时间关系
structure: 定语从句：先行词 + who/which/that + 从句；时间状语从句：when/while/before/after + 从句
explanation: 定语从句中，who/whom指人，which指物，that指人或物均可，在从句中作主语或宾语。时间状语从句连接两个有时间关系的分句，主句和从句时态需保持逻辑一致。

examples.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
examples.zh: 住在隔壁的那个人是位医生。

examples.en: This is the book that I borrowed yesterday.
examples.zh: 这就是我昨天借的那本书。

examples.en: I will call you when I arrive.

practice.question: The woman ___ is standing there is my teacher.
practice.explanation: 先行词woman指人，用who。

practice.question: This is the movie ___ we watched last night.
practice.explanation: 先行词movie指物，可用that。

practice.question: ___ I was walking home, it started to rain.
practice.explanation: 表示动作同时发生，用While引导时间状语从句。

title: 被动语态
summary: 强调动作的承受者而非执行者
structure: 主语（动作承受者） + be动词 + 过去分词 + (by 动作执行者)
explanation: 当不知道或不需要强调谁执行动作时，常用被动语态。be动词随时态和主语变化，过去分词保持不变。

examples.en: The window was broken by the storm.
English is spoken in many countries.
examples.zh: 英语在许多国家被使用。

examples.en: This report will be finished tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这份报告将于明天完成。

practice.question: The letter ___ (send) yesterday.
practice.explanation: 过去发生的被动动作：was/were + 过去分词。

practice.question: This cake ___ (make) by my mother every year.
practice.explanation: 一般现在时被动语态：is/are + 过去分词。

practice.question: The bridge ___ (build) next year.
practice.explanation: 将来时被动语态：will be + 过去分词。
